summary: Iteration 22: focused end-to-end verification of the 5 features shipped this turn (Restauration admin CRUD, Formations form_url + cover_image + Formation complète badge, Avantages CSE MS Group CTA, admin-mode gating for Actualités/Formations/Restauration). Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass. Frontend: full CRUD flow of a product from /management/restauration → immediately reflected on /restaurant (create, edit, delete). Admin-mode OFF correctly blocks /management/restauration and /management/formations with a friendly 'Mode administrateur désactivé' card. Formations manager exposes ImageUpload for cover_image (testid formation-cover*) and 'Lien du formulaire' input (testid formation-form-url). Employee registration surfaces the external form button (formation-form-<id>) with the exact URL saved by admin. A capacity=1 formation shows the red 'Formation complète' badge and disables the register button with label 'Formation complète' for non-registered users. /avantages CSE MS Group CTA (testid cse-ms-group-link) links to https://ms-group-rewards.preview.emergentagent.com with target=_blank. Admin-mode toggle correctly hides the MS Park composer on Actualités and hides the admin sidebar block.

issues: The 'Tous (n)' chip has no data-testid (only per-store chips do). Minor testability gap — consider adding data-testid='filter-store-all'.

action_items: Optional/minor: add data-testid='filter-store-all' to the 'Tous' chip in RestaurationManager for stronger test coverage.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py ProductPayload + admin_create/update/delete_product correctly gate on require_admin() and always project out _id; response is JSON serializable. GET /api/menu already picks up new products (no cache).
FormationCreate now accepts form_url and cover_image (line ~5625). Both fields round-trip through POST/PUT/GET as verified by test suite.

Formations.jsx isFull uses registrations_count from backend, which matches the participants.length count on the server, so 'Formation complète' badge/label logic is correct even though frontend does not read participants[] directly.
RestaurationManager.jsx and FormationsManager both correctly early-return with 'Mode administrateur désactivé' when adminMode !== true, preventing accidental mutations from stale admin UIs.
test_credentials: admin: emp-marcus-simeo (X-Employee-Id) / employee: emp-idriss-malonga. Login-form creds in /app/memory/test_credentials.md but frontend also honors localStorage.ms_employee_id directly.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up transient products ('Test Auto Frites XL' → 'Test Auto Frites Ultra') and two transient formations ('TEST QA Formation FormURL' and 'TEST_FULL_<hex>' capacity=1 with Idriss registered). All deleted at the end of the run — no residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is mocked in-memory MongoDB (recreated at each startup) but /api endpoints match prod. Auth is X-Employee-Id header; frontend reads it from localStorage 'ms_employee_id' and adminMode from localStorage 'adminMode' ('true'|'false'). To test admin UI: set both keys and reload. RestaurationManager filter chips: only per-store chips have data-testid (filter-store-soccer_bar, ..._donut_house, ..._stand_crepes, ..._stand_bonbons); 'Tous' has none. Formations page uses registrations_count (not participants[].length) — backend already exposes this correctly.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — this iteration is a feature-verification pass, no bugs uncovered.
